text:
elaine_cs: Quick heads-up — weekly deep-dive for ClearView's cache + batching health. Seeing some odd variance in batch size and a rising tail latency. Sharing the snapshot below, please react with :eyes: if you can join a short triage.
jordan_se: Pasted the numbers I pulled this morning (15m rollups):
```
window: 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-21
total_calls: 1,183,412
avg_batch_size: 6.3
median_batch_size: 5
batch_size_p90: 12
cache_hit_rate: 0.42
cache_hit_rate_prev_week: 0.57
p50_latency_ms: 86
p95_latency_ms: 210
p99_latency_ms: 472
error_rate: 0.003 (0.3%)
cost_per_1k_tokens: $2.84
notes: small average batch + low hit rate driving up tokens/call and cost
```
mike_infra: Looks like more single-request traffic during their morning window — batching window might be too narrow. Also seeing more cache evictions for the 4k+ user prompts. Could be TTL or sharded cache pressure.

elaine_cs: @karim_clearview any recent product changes or spike in short prompts? That would explain smaller batches.

karim_clearview: We rolled out a conversational UI tweak last week that sends an immediate validation call on focus, then the main call on submit. Ops said they'd batch those locally but maybe not working consistently. Will check.

ops-bot: CI-alert: ClearView routing policy change detected on 2026-03-18 03:12 UTC — new canary enabled for client-side debounce (id: cb-debounce-v2).

jordan_se: If client-side debounce failing, server batching won't help. Two paths: 1) enforce server-side batching window (quick), 2) coordinate with ClearView to fix debounce (longer but best). Also can flip on prefix caching for common validation tokens.

elaine_cs: Cost impact estimate if avg batch size stays at 6.3 vs target 10: ~28% higher token spend. If hit rate goes from 0.42 -> 0.6 we'd save ~15% on per-token compute. Quick math attached.

mike_infra: Suggested infra steps: increase server batching window from 8ms -> 25ms for this tenant only (low risk, they accept slightly higher median latency) and enable soft-prefetch of KV cache for known prefixes. I can ship a config patch today.

karim_clearview: We can push a client patch this week to collapse validation+submit into one call. ETA EOD Thursday.

elaine_cs: Action items:
- mike_infra: roll config patch to bump tenant batching window (target: 25ms) — owner: @mike_infra — due: 2026-03-22
- jordan_se: add a temporary server-side debounce fallback if requests come from same session within 20ms — owner: @jordan_se — due: 2026-03-22
- karim_clearview: client fix to collapse calls — owner: @karim_clearview — due: 2026-03-25
- elaine_cs: follow-up check next Monday with updated metrics

jordan_se: I'll also add a small eval to track cache-hit variance by prompt shape so we can present to the product team.

mike_infra: I will monitor p99 during rollout and have rollback ready. If we see p50 increase > 40ms, revert.

elaine_cs: Thanks all. If anyone wants to join a 15m sync tomorrow 11:00 PST ping me. Otherwise I'll post updated numbers after config patch.

karim_clearview: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround :raised_hands:
thread_summary: Weekly ClearView cache+batch deep-dive: avg batch size small (6.3), cache hit rate down (0.42), p99 latency 472ms, cost per 1k tokens $2.84. Agreed actions: bump tenant batching window, add server-side debounce fallback, client patch to collapse validation+submit. Owners and due dates assigned.
